notes: melonDS (Nintendo DS): pkgforge-dev's sharun repackaging of melonDS 1.1.
-f: fullscreen; the ROM boots at once (--boot defaults to auto). melonDS's -b is --boot <auto|always|never>, not a batch mode.

melonDS never quits when a game stops and has no quit hotkey nor button combinations, so Select + Start cannot reach an exit: OpenGamepadUI's Exit (SIGTERM) is the way out. SIGTERM ends it at once, no dialog; the .sav is written ~2 s after the game saves.
gui_args: melonDS's own window (touch screen; no pad-driven UI).

LD_PRELOAD qforge-hidemenu (apps/qforge-hidemenu): on a dual-screen board melonDS's second window (Instance0.Window1, the DS bottom screen) goes to the second panel, but melonDS hides a window's menu bar only when that window is fullscreen and -f fullscreens the first window alone, so File / System / ... showed above the bottom screen (HW 2026-10-12, Thor Lite). The shim zeroes the height of every menu bar after the first window's; with one window (single-screen boards, --gui) nothing changes. sharun drops LD_PRELOAD unless SHARUN_ALLOW_LD_PRELOAD is set.

Dual-screen boards (device-env QFORGE_SECONDARY_CONNECTOR set): melonDS-dual-screen.toml is seeded instead. It enables the second window (Instance0.Window1), which gamescope sends to the second panel by its '[w2] ' title (gamescope patch 0041), with the top screen alone in the first window (ScreenSizing 4) and the bottom screen alone in the second (5). exit_resend 2: with the second window open melonDS does not exit on SIGTERM at all (its handler calls qApp->quit() inside the signal and never gets through; deferring it to the GLib loop with qforge-sigdefer did not help either), so OGUI's Exit had to be pressed twice, i.e. SIGKILL the whole tree and leave a dead mount (HW 2026-10-12, Thor Lite). The launcher sends one more SIGTERM after 2 s and SIGKILLs melonDS alone 2 s later, then releases the mount as usual. Nothing is lost: the .sav is written ~2 s after the game saves.
